# AEO Command

> Multi-tenant Answer Engine Optimization (AEO / GEO) platform for marketing agencies. Publisher: Threezero Agency (https://threezero.agency).

AEO Command is software for agencies that deliver Answer Engine Optimization as a client service. It is not a one-off free score checker. Agencies paste a client website URL, run a scan, work a prioritized Action Center of assignable fixes, track AI visibility prompts over time, and share a white-label live report link under the agency brand.

## Product identity

- Official name: AEO Command
- Publisher: Threezero Agency
- Category: BusinessApplication / multi-tenant SaaS
- Primary users: agency owners and account teams managing multiple client domains
- Core differentiator: multi-tenant agencyId isolation + Action Center workflow + white-label reports (not monitoring-only)

## Core workflow

1. Add a client and paste their public website URL
2. Run an AEO scan (crawl + analysis; Firecrawl/Claude optional)
3. Open the prioritized Action Center — tasks with suggested fixes, assignable to team members
4. Track visibility prompts (heuristics and optional live Perplexity) over time
5. Share a white-label live report URL with the client

## Product facts

- Strict multi-tenant isolation by agencyId on clients, scans, actions, and reports
- Roles: SUPER_ADMIN, AGENCY_OWNER, AGENCY_MEMBER
- Pakistan and International pricing tiers with 14-day free trial
- Optional Stripe billing, Inngest durable jobs, Resend email
- Re-scan schedules and weekly digests when configured
